scope: Disposable Kind v1.36.1 cluster. Creates an owned namespace, one digest-pinned synthetic mock workload, a default-deny NetworkPolicy, and a named-object read-only Role. Captures API-visible posture, detects controlled changes to Pod Security Admission labels, NetworkPolicy rules and Role verbs, reapplies the desired manifests, and verifies recovery from live API reads. Joins an offline fictional advisory fixture to a synthetic component observation. Pinned offline OSV-Scanner reads the inert package metadata in a case-built runnable image, and the posture result binds to the exact image observed in Kind. Benchmark coverage, actual advisory feeds, managed and accelerator settings, and deployed monitoring and alerting have separate evidence requirements. A scoped authenticated Role stream compares fixture metadata updates, rule widening and restoration with exact API event revisions. A separately authorized NetworkPolicy watcher matches metadata, ingress widening and restoration to the selected object's UID and API resource versions. The NetworkPolicy comparison uses API observations only; CNI enforcement and ongoing monitoring require separate evidence. The watcher also emits fixture-scoped Warning Events for drift transitions, bound to policy revisions and observer Pod identity; this does not establish durable or external alert delivery. A separate disposable Kind profile tests stale NetworkPolicy resourceVersion recovery with a one-resource cache bypass and bounded compaction cadence; the original profile retains its defaults.

checks.claim: Owned resources begin at the declared restricted baseline
Offline fictional component metadata joins exactly and the version near miss stays unmatched
Posture assessment detects each controlled owned-resource regression
Reapplying the owned desired state restores API-observed posture
Changes outside the explicitly owned fixture scope do not alter its assessment
Pinned OSV result is bound through the preserved OCI subject to a Pod that ran the image in the owned namespace
Missing, failed, misbound and unknown scanner evidence never becomes a healthy posture result
The disposable registry container and volume were removed
Named Role list and watch succeed while unfiltered and different-name watches receive 403
Live Role watch distinguishes metadata, policy widening and restored policy on one UID
Named NetworkPolicy list and watch succeed while broader and different-name watches receive 403
NetworkPolicy watch classifies metadata, ingress widening and restoration against exact writes and event times
NetworkPolicy watch resumes from the last received revision and observes drift missed while disconnected
The watcher emits exactly one persisted Warning Event for each observed NetworkPolicy drift revision
The watcher identity cannot create or leave an alert Event in the neighboring namespace
Stale named NetworkPolicy watch receives a real 410 and same observer relists exact owned state
Same observer resumes from fresh collection resourceVersion and matches next drift and recovery writes
